title: Renew Chatgpt subscription?
author: Caninetechnology
selftext:
I have been feeling the worst fomo all month looking at everyone's opus 5.5 games while my Astra/Sol6.1 game still looks like shit. I have max tier subscription and I'm waiting for it to cancel before going to Claude. 

  
Should I stick with a max subscription to claude, or split $100 subscriptions for both chatgpt and claude? Knowing my luck the day I subscribe to Claude, Astra 6.9 will come out and be the greatest thing ever.

comments.author: Melodic-Chemistry127
comments.body:
Go Claude for now, it's just better now. Once someone else releases a better model, sub to them. That's how it has been for a while, and it is going to be like that for the foreseeable future. If you don't have spare cash to throw around, just sub monthly. Worst case you stay locked to Claude for a couple of weeks. And even so, just because OpenAI comes up with something better, it's not going to make Claude any worse.

One thing that is going for Anthropic is that you get more model usage for the same price, so it will always be very good value until they change that.

comments.author: theriftreport
comments.body: I’m in the same boat and I’m going to split. Mostly because I use ChatGPT business features extensively in my day job and we are finding Dot and Space incredibly useful. I was previously on Claude, moved over to Codex exclusively as it was outperforming Claude for me for a while (and giving me a ton more usage). But I’ve already gone for the $100 Claude as I couldn’t resist any longer and I’ve been using it almost exclusively while just running some massive jobs on Astra to try and squeeze some value from my 200 sub. It’s so easy to switch between them that splitting seems like the sensible move for me at the moment, but if I wasn’t using features outside of Codex I’d be tempted to go all in on Claude at least until the balance of power changes again.

comments.body: honestly I have no idea why anyone would use codex for anything. I don't care which model they have out, when it comes to coding, no one is even close to anthropics models and never wa

replies.author: count023
replies.body:
Because that's an incredibly narrow worldview and way to make a other apple worshipping cult. 

I use both in parallel, you get more bang from your buck with a codex sub thanks to the Tibo reset obsession. Both models are about the same once you get used to their flows and which one works better for what.

Not everyone can piss away money on a whim, value is a high priority for a lot of people in this age of subscription gouging.

comments.author: Batty25111
comments.body:
Opus 5.5 and Fable 5.1 are the most capable models. I have spent months with 3 subscriptions with Codex. It will make shit but it can never ever finish it because your constantly fighting with their models to stay on track. You keep hoping every new release "maybe this model will be better" I got a Max plan with Anthropic and I was able to finish projects I could never with Codex.

Claude Code now for life unless Anthropic massively drops the ball and all their shit gets nerfed again

comments.body: I use both and I’ve started integrating Argon as well. $20 tier for all 3 allows me to never have any downtime in workflow, never have to worry about buying tokens, and can always keep working when I want to. They all talk to each other extremely well.
